notes.title: The Gravity Trickster Demo
notes.content:
Join me for the Live Stream, where I play through the demo version of my solo developed game, The Gravity Trickster, a 3D puzzle platformer.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837083/cd6147de37c60f72bc83344ec3754987c0cb3917.png
Ask me anything during the stream.

Visit to website and feel free to reach out later if you missed the Stream:
https://thegravitytrickster.com/
For latest new, check The Gravity Trickster on Social Media:
Facebook

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837083/90e68fe11f6fc8ceea5dfbed9ec63fae4b0b230d.png

The full version will be available on Steam this July!
